tasks.label: Tests: run locally (layer, suite, browser)
tasks.detail: Spec 000 RF-90 / RF-93: runs the picked layer, suite and browser on the checked-out branch through npm run ci:run-suite

tasks.label: Tests: unit tests
tasks.detail: Vitest unit tests of the framework (no network); writes reports/unit-results.json for npm run report:failures

tasks.label: Tests: unit tests with coverage
tasks.detail: As in CI: results in reports/unit-results.json, coverage in reports/coverage/index.html

tasks.label: Tests: open Playwright report
tasks.detail: Opens the HTML report of the last local Playwright run

tasks.label: Tests: list last failures
tasks.detail: Spec 000 RF-96: lists the failed tests of the last local run with their error, trace and screenshot (secrets redacted)

tasks.label: Claude: analyze and fix last failure
tasks.detail: Spec 000 RF-97: opens Claude Code with /fix-failure: explains the cause, fixes it test-first, re-runs it and records it in docs/bug-log.md (no commit, no push)

tasks.label: GitHub: start manual run (branch, suite, browser, layer)
tasks.detail: Spec 000 RF-80 / RF-93: starts the manual CI run on the picked branch; a regression starts from eyter_dev and continues to release, main and production (RF-91, RF-92)
tasks.command: gh workflow run ci.yml --ref ${input:branch} -f suite=${input:suite} -f browser=${input:browser} -f layer=${input:layer}

tasks.label: GitHub: watch run
tasks.detail: Follows a running workflow run (pick it from the list)
